---
title: "Contributing"
---

Contributions are welcome! This page provides information on how to set up the development environment and contribute to PageSieve.

## Development Setup

1. Clone the repository: `git clone https://github.com/julius383/PageSieve.git`
2. Install dependencies: `bun install`
3. Start the build process: `bun run build:extension` (for production)

## Build Commands

- `bun run build:extension`: Generates the production extension in `apps/extension/dist/`.
- `bun run build:cli`: Generates the CLI bundle in `apps/cli/dist/`.
- `bun run lint`: Runs ESLint to check for code quality issues across packages and apps.
- `bun run format`: Formats the codebase using Prettier.

## Just Tasks

If you have [just](https://github.com/casey/just) installed, you can use the following commands:

- `just build-extension`: Build the browser extension.
- `just build-cli`: Build the CLI application.
- `just watch`: Start file watcher to rebuild upon changes.
- `just lint`: Lint the monorepo.
- `just format`: Format the monorepo.
- `just docs-preview`: Start a local Quarto documentation preview server.
- `just docs-build`: Render the documentation site.

## Submitting Changes

1. Fork the repository.
2. Create a new branch for your changes.
3. Commit your changes and push them to your fork.
4. Submit a pull request with a clear description of your changes.
